title: 3 Reasons Investors Should Ignore Cipher Digital's Double Miss
author: Marc Guberti
description: Cipher Digital missed Q2 earnings and revenue estimates, but the company is pivoting from crypto mining to AI data centers. The company started delivering high-performance compute capacity ahead of schedule with a $5.5 billion, 15-year Amazon deal generating $367 million in annual recurring revenue. Additional catalysts include a 900-megawatt site option near San Antonio and full funding of the 100-megawatt Stingray facility, positioning the company to rely less on debt financing.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite missing Q2 earnings and revenue estimates, the company is executing ahead of schedule on AI infrastructure projects, securing a major $5.5 billion Amazon contract, acquiring new site options, and achieving full funding for expansion projects, which positions it for strong future cash flow generation and reduced debt reliance.
Amazon is mentioned as a strategic tenant securing long-term compute capacity deals with Cipher Digital, but the article focuses on Cipher Digital's perspective rather than Amazon's business impact.

title: Cipher Digital Inc. Announces Pricing of $810.0 Million of Senior Secured Notes
author: Globe Newswire
description: Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: CIFR) announced that its subsidiary Stingray Compute LLC has priced an $810.0 million offering of 6.000% senior secured notes due 2031 at 99.750% of principal amount. The net proceeds will finance the remaining costs of the Stingray data center facility, reimburse approximately $61.5 million in prior equity contributions, and fund debt service reserves. The offering is expected to close on June 15, 2026.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company successfully priced a substantial $810 million debt offering at favorable terms (99.750% of par), demonstrating strong investor confidence and access to capital markets. The financing enables completion of the Stingray data center facility, supporting the company's growth strategy in the high-demand HPC data center market.

title: Cipher Digital Announces Participation in Upcoming Investor and Industry Conferences
author: Na
description: Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: CIFR), an industrial-scale data center developer and operator, announced its participation in four upcoming industry conferences in May and June 2026, including the Needham Technology Conference, Macquarie Asia Conference, Goldman Sachs Leveraged Finance Conference, and Citizens Digital Infrastructure Forum. CEO Tyler Page may be featured in discussions about the company's recent developments and growth strategy, with webcasts to be posted on the company's investor website.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The company is actively participating in multiple prestigious industry conferences and recently signed a third AI data center campus lease with an investment-grade hyperscale tenant, indicating strong business momentum, growth trajectory, and investor confidence in the company's strategic direction.

title: Hut 8, Cipher Digital Stocks Boom As AI Data Center Deals Fuel Rally
author: Erica Kollmann
description: Hut 8 and Cipher Digital stocks surged on strong AI data center lease announcements. Hut 8 signed a 15-year, $9.8 billion deal (potentially $25.1 billion with renewals) for 352 MW of AI capacity, while Cipher Digital signed its third AI data center campus lease with a hyperscale tenant. Both companies are pivoting from crypto mining to high-performance computing infrastructure, attracting investor interest in contracted capacity and long-duration AI revenue.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Stock surged 34.8% following announcement of major 15-year AI data center lease worth $9.8 billion in base-term contract value with potential to reach $25.1 billion. Expanded total contracted capacity to 597 MW across two campuses with $16.8 billion in aggregate contract value, demonstrating strong market demand for AI infrastructure.

Stock closed up 23.5% after reporting Q1 results and announcing third AI data center campus lease with investment-grade hyperscale tenant. Company successfully converting power access into long-duration AI data center revenue, showing momentum in AI and HPC data center segments.

title: Why Cipher Digital Stock Is Skyrocketing Today
author: Keith Noonan
description: Cipher Digital stock surged 23.59% despite missing Q1 earnings and sales expectations. The company reported a loss of $0.28 per share on $34.84 million in sales, with revenue down 29% year-over-year. However, investors responded positively to the announcement of a new $200 million revolving credit facility, which will support the company's strategic pivot from cryptocurrency mining to AI infrastructure technologies.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Despite disappointing Q1 financial results (earnings and revenue misses), the stock gained 23.59% due to investor optimism about the company's strategic shift to AI infrastructure and the secured $200 million revolving credit facility to fund this transition. The market is valuing future potential over current performance.
